excludedInfrastructure.reason: Mixed production orchestration and historical compatibility are execution implementation, not reusable problem knowledge.
Durability and activity execution belong to the replaceable workflow provider layer.
OCI packaging is release infrastructure and a replaceable capability provider, not Artifact problem ontology.
Transport/effect reconciliation belongs to delivery infrastructure rather than Artifact classification or validation knowledge.
Environment probing is provider integration and should remain replaceable.

migrationClasses.DIRECT_REFERENCE: Keep the source semantics and provenance as-is; only relocate/index later.
migrationClasses.DO_NOT_PROMOTE: Keep only as a replaceable execution/provider adapter or historical implementation; never treat it as Core ontology.
migrationClasses.SEMANTIC_MAPPING: Map the source concept into future Common Contracts without assuming the current Artifact schema is universal.

principles: reference proven Artifact assets instead of copying or re-owning them
preserve external standards and tool identities as knowledge/capability references
do not infer workflow sequence when the source profile did not encode sequence
do not promote Temporal, Runtime, transport or legacy delivery wiring into Ordivon Core
candidateProblemKey is a donor lookup key, not a universal Core ontology commitment
profile PASS boundaries and nonClaims migrate with the validation knowledge
